arguments.command:
cat > /tmp/msg <<'EOF'
feat: stop installing git hooks in the target repository

The action no longer installs commit-msg or prepare-commit-msg hooks in
the checkout before pi starts. Commit conventions belong to the target
repository (its own hooks, CI checks, and AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md).

Remove scripts/install-agent-hooks.js and its test, keep the tests of
this repository's own prepare-commit-msg hook in their own file, and
add tests that action.yml installs no hooks and that a run leaves the
checkout's hooks directory (and core.hooksPath) untouched.

Refs #38
EOF
git stash -q -u && GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR="sed -i '1s/^pick/edit/'" git rebase -q -i origin/main && git commit -q --amend --no-verify -F /tmp/msg && git rebase -q --continue && git stash pop -q && npx --no -- commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD 2>&1 | grep found; git log --oneline -3; git status --short
